title.narrative: Activity under preparation Youth Engagment Hub (YEH)

description.narrative: The Youth Engagement Hub (YEH) aims at facilitating the integration of youth perspective in policy development and implementation and youth-led initiatives at country level, leveraging young people¿s insights, innovation capacity, and building trustful relationships. Complementing already ongoing initiatives such as the Women and Youth in Democratic Engagement, the Youth Empowerment Fund and national level actions by EU Delegations, the action will support the implementation of the Youth Action Plan in EU external action for 2022-2027 in the roll out of the Global Gateway strategy. It will also contribute to the commitments in the European Commission President¿s Political Guidelines 2024-2029 by ensuring intergenerational fairness and making ¿sure that young people can use their voice ¿ their own voice ¿ to help shape our future¿.The action responds to the demands of young people to be engaged in policy-making and contribute to the EU priorities and provides support to EU Delegation to strengthen their institutional youth engagement by implementing initiatives developed with the advice of their Youth Sounding Boards. The action also responds to the needs of the EU, including the European Commission and EU Delegations, to further embed youth engagment in the EU policy processes and the Global Gateway priorities. The YEH will connect young people¿s needs and interests with Global Gateway priorities at country level. With the objective to strengthen the partnership between the EU and young people through enhanced youth engagement with a focus on policy development, the action will aim at:Increasing institutional youth engagement in policy development and implementation, in particular to advance the roll out of the Global Gateway strategy in line with the Youth Action Plan and EUDs priorities.Supporting youth-led initiatives, inlcuding those developed with the advice of Youth Sounding Boards.Building on the principle of partnership, the action will allow for strong(er) cooperation between EU Delegations, Youth Sounding Boards and young people as well as promoting broader inclusion of young people and the participation of EU MSs, the private sector, partner countries and other interested stakeholders. The action will strengthen capacity-building around youth participation and empowerment of all involved actors and strengthen the youth relevance of EU actions across Global Gateway priorities.The action supports the contribution of young generations as key agents for the implementation of the Sustainable Development Goals, to promoting stronger, peaceful, democratic and inclusive societies for sustainable development and building effective, accountable and inclusive institutions at all levels (SDG 16 ¿Peace, justice and strong institutions¿). It contributes to the EU commitments to support the broad implementation of the United Nations SDGs (4 ¿Quality Education¿, 5 ¿Gender Equality¿, 8 ¿Decent Work and Economic Growth¿, 10 ¿Reduce inequalities¿, 11 ¿Sustainable cities and Communities¿, 13 ¿Climate Action¿, 17 ¿Partnerships¿ etc.) and the UN Youth, Peace and Security Agenda.
